title: Legacy Signal Card Migration Record
description: Audit and translation record for one legacy Signal Card. Not a canonical Signal Card. Not validated against signal_card.schema.json.

migration_id.description: Unique ID for this migration record

legacy_signal_id.description: Original Signal Card ID from the legacy corpus (e.g. SC-R1-047)

legacy_source_type_raw.description: Raw value of source_type as it appears in the legacy card. Preserved verbatim.

legacy_evidence_role_raw.description: Raw value of evidence_role or equivalent as it appears in the legacy card. Null if field did not exist.

legacy_source_ref_raw.description: Raw value of source, url, source_ref or equivalent as it appears in the legacy card. Preserved verbatim.

legacy_source_label_raw.description: Raw human-readable label or title of the source as it appears in the legacy card.

canonical_source_type.description: Proposed canonical source_type from the new ontology. Null if not mappable.

canonical_source_type_confidence.description: Confidence in the proposed canonical_source_type mapping.

canonical_evidence_role.description: Proposed canonical evidence_role from the new ontology. Null if not mappable.

canonical_evidence_role_confidence.description: Confidence in the proposed canonical_evidence_role mapping.

traceability_grade.description: Assessment of how traceable the legacy card is back to its original source.

recoverability_status.description: Overall migration outcome for this legacy card.

reference_available.description: Is any source reference (URL, label, or partial ref) present in the legacy card?

reference_stable.description: Is the source reference stable enough to be retrieved or verified?

source_type_mappable.description: Can legacy_source_type_raw be mapped to a canonical source_type value?

evidence_role_mappable.description: Can legacy_evidence_role_raw (or inferred role) be mapped to a canonical evidence_role value?

snippet_verifiability.description: Is the evidence_base or snippet in the legacy card verifiable against a traceable source?

legacy_value_requires_enum_extension.description: Does the legacy card use a value that was not in the old enum and is not in the new enum either? Signals a schema_gap.

failure_reasons.description: Failure codes triggered during migration. Empty array if clean_mappable.

migration_notes.description: Operational notes about this migration record. Never market interpretation.

suggested_followup.description: Suggested next action for this record. Null if no follow-up needed.

migrated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp or date string of when this migration record was produced.

migrated_by.description: Agent or operator that produced this migration record.
